instruction_field_scope: operator execution mode, not a verbatim quotation of the human user
basis: Trusted human user replied continue after delivery of the concrete F0 SHA and Draft PR, then repeated continue after the exact SHA and review request were shown again. The latest direct instruction is treated as approval to run that delivered version. This is contextual authorization; no claim that the user inspected every document.
authorization_form_deviation: USER_SPECIFICATION and JOINT_PROTOCOL request literal EXECUTE_FROZEN plus full SHA. The user instead gave repeated direct continue instructions in response to the concrete F0 review request. Actual wording and this interpretation are retained, not rewritten as a literal human command. Frozen numerical source, protocol parameters, task cohort, schedule and all scientific gates remain unchanged.
chronology: Authorization recorded after exact F0 remote receipt and before F1, any reserved model forward, A live or B formal execution.
